How Brookswood compares with the rest of Langley

items.t: Houses in Brookswood have the 6th highest median of 9 Langley sub-areas, $1,415,000. Aldergrove is lowest at $1,025,000 and Campbell Valley highest at $2,565,000. Walnut Grove ($1,344,250) sits just below and Willoughby Heights ($1,470,000) sits just above.
